feat(api): standardize API response envelope
Introduce a consistent ApiResponse envelope for JSON API responses, add public response DTOs, centralize error handling, and prevent passwordHash from being exposed in user responses.
Also update Auth/User/Pet controller responses, security error handling, OpenAPI documentation, HTTP client token extraction, and integration tests for success and error flows.
